svg.aria-label: Astra Harness: a person works with an AI; conversations, commits and reviews leave traces anyway. The same correction showing up in two tasks is grouped as one common cause, laid against a run that went well to find the missing step; the person approves a single change at the head of the process; days later the same correction no longer appears.
